column1: # Level-1 audio trace: the RETAIL-derived reference (issue #13).
# Same columns and the same fixed 600 ms sample ticks as `level1-audio-port.tsv`.
# Provenance:
#   music range      `01_SoundTrack.cog`'s `startup`: `PlaySong(12, 13, 12)` then `SetMusicVol(0.0)`,
#                    which is what the level's own cog values (`starttrack=12`, `endtrack=13`,
#                    `loopto=12`) make it call.
#   music_vol        the script's own fade: `crossed` sets delta +0.05 for `linkid=1` (onAdjoin) and
#                    -0.1 for `linkid=0` (offAdjoin), arms `SetPulse(0.1)`, and `pulse` adds delta
#                    every 100 ms. Leaving the bar (the bar_in leg's first walk tick) starts the
#                    +0.05 ramp; walking back in (bar_out's first walk tick) starts the -0.1 ramp.
#                    The samples below evaluate that model at the route's 600 ms cadence.
#   ambient          the sector's own `SOUND` row, for the sector RETAIL's body is in
#                    (`level1-route-retail.tsv` for the four shared legs; the bar legs' sectors come
#                    from the level's geometry). 339 = 01cantinaband02.wav/0.3, 254 = 00techamb03.wav/0.2,
#                    19 = 01cantinaband02.wav/0.6; 156/271/155/328/20 name no loop.
#   -                a field this reference does not record:
#                      * ambience where the port's body is in a different sector than retail's
#                        (issue #10's movement parity owns that difference: ticks 36-144 and 288);
#                      * `sounds` on every row: no retail audio capture exists yet, and the route's
#                        one-shots (an actor's `reeyee02.wav`, shots' `trprsht1.wav`) depend on AI
#                        timing, not on authored data. The comparator's missing/extra/mistimed/
#                        attenuated classification is exercised by `audio-gate.ps1 -Perturb` and by
#                        `route_tests` in `src/main.rs`.
# The tolerance (`BK_AUDIO_EPSILON`, the gate passes 0.12) absorbs two 0.1 s pulse steps: the VM's
# frame clock accumulates 1/60 s in f32, so a pulse boundary lands one frame either side of the
# model's 100 ms grid.
